title: top-up: pre-push deno test baseline gate and babysitter tree gate
definition: module added for the pre-push gate's deno test check: classify a module-fetch failure as infrastructure, downgrade a failure already red at the fork point to a warning, and fail closed on every other failed run (#4930). babysitter_ready.ts is the shared BABYSITTER_READY rule; babysitter_tree_gate.ts is the pre-push gate over a babysitter repair's uncommitted tree with a read-only .git, the git-seam emulation of the baseline worktree as a real git checkout under a temp root that borrows the clone's objects through alternates, the path scoping and merged-base baseline over an uncommitted base merge, the tree-pollution check, gate-marker neutralisation and redaction (#4930).
